sections.title: Music Register Map
sections.md:
One family for the film: low piano, bowed double bass and a soft muted pulse, the same four-note figure developing. **The product's first frame is SC05-SH21 (~3:40); the music changes there.** Everything before it is investigation — never sad (`NEG-SAD`), never cute (`NEG-MUSIC`).

| Cue | Scenes | ≈ time | Register | From the script's own lines | Sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MUS-SC01 | SC01–SC02 | 0:00–1:10 | **MUS-OPEN** | "Is your dad alright?" · "if that lad hadn't been there" — the viewer is unsettled and wants to know why | low drone, a slow heartbeat pulse, single piano notes, unresolved; drops out under "Is your dad alright?" |
| MUS-SC03 | SC03–SC04 | 1:10–1:56 | **MUS-EXPOSE** | "Now I can't get across a car park to my own wife" · "It's very normal" — the problem exposed | darker low strings, a ticking pulse; investigation, not grief |
| MUS-SC05 | SC05 to SH20 | 1:56–3:40 | **MUS-EDU** | "Where does it hurt? All round the knee, or one spot?" · "seventeen times your bodyweight" | inquisitive: pizzicato bass, a soft clock-like figure, rising questions |
| MUS-SC05b | SC05-SH21 → SC06 | 3:40–4:25 | **MUS-TURN** | "I took the weight off it. Stryde." — the release | the four-note figure resolves for the first time on the strap's first frame (±0.25 s) |
| MUS-SC07 | SC07–SC09 | 4:25–5:09 | **MUS-AFTER** | "First time in two years, I came down my own stairs forwards" · "She's fine. Thanks, love." | warm piano and strings, hopeful, walking pace — never cute or upbeat |
| MUS-SC10 | SC10 | 5:09–5:38 | **MUS-OFFER** | "It's not your age… You're overloaded" · "If the link's still there, grab it now" | confident, resolved, the figure in full |

The music is made at the edit stage (`music.py plan --register` → `compose` → `check`, listened to before it goes on the board), never in a clip (`NEG-SOUND`, silent Seedance calls when nobody speaks).
